data.one_liner: Dart Dio client generator using source_gen
data.what_it_does: Retrofit.dart generates typed Dio API clients from annotated interfaces. It uses source_gen to produce boilerplate, enabling compile‑time type safety and easy HTTP method mapping.
use_when: Need a typed API client for a REST service
Want to avoid writing repetitive Dio request code
Prefer a Retrofit‑style declarative API definition
Require support for many HTTP methods and custom headers
avoid_when: You prefer not to use code generation
You are already using the plain http package
You need a lightweight solution without Dio
strengths: Strong type safety with Dart generics
Supports custom headers, query params, body extras
Extensible via CallAdapters and DartMappable parser
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and extra dev dependency
Tied to Dio, not the standard http client
data.setup_notes: Add retrofit and retrofit_generator to dependencies/dev_dependencies, run `dart pub run build_runner build` or watch. No special permissions needed.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct use of Dio without code generation, simpler for small projects

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard HTTP client with no codegen, lighter weight
